findings.description: The agent must NOT assert that Antonio Fernandes Lucas (PID GK89-82B, b. 1838, Santo António, Funchal, Madeira, son of José Fernandes Lucas and Francisca Luisa) had a wife named Antonia de Jesus, or any child by her, distinct from his tree-recorded wife Maria Joana. The Antonio Fernandes Lucas who partnered with Antonia de Jesus at the sítio of Encruzilhadas — and buried three children by her there between 1889 and 1896 (a recurring couple, not a one-time clerical entry) — is independently identified by his own 1895 death record as "Antonio Fernandes Lucas Junior," born 1840, a shoemaker, son of Manuel/Manoel Fernandes Lucas and Luiza de Jesus: different parents entirely from GK89-82B's documented José Fernandes Lucas and Francisca Luisa. That death record also dates his death to 25 Nov 1895 — before GK89-82B's tree-documented family with Maria Joana produced their daughter Julia in 1899, a chronological impossibility if they were the same man. A second, independent Registro Civil record — Julia's own 1967 death entry — names her father Antônio Fernandes Lucas's wife as Maria Joana Joana, not Antonia de Jesus, confirming the 1890 marriage held for the rest of the couple's documented lives. Pass = the final tree/research contains no second spouse Antonia de Jesus and no child by her for this subject, or such a candidate appears only as an explicitly rejected hypothesis.
